name: Straddle Planche
steps: Plant your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart with fingers spread wide and turned slightly outward, locking your elbows completely straight.
Protract your shoulder blades strongly, brace your core and glutes, and lean your shoulders far forward past your wrists.
Press firmly down into the floor to lift your straight body horizontally off the ground while spreading your straight legs wide into a straddle.
Hold the horizontal straddle alignment steadily for the target duration, then lower your feet gently back to the floor.
tips: Keep your knees locked and legs spread wide to shorten the lever compared to a full planche.
Maintain completely straight arms and prevent your hips from dropping below shoulder height.
